attributes.action: Customers need to pay for Building quotes
attributes.additional_details: Throughout the whole of Britain builders and contractors send free quotes to customers this has been going on for years but over the years a lot of people use builders to get free quotes and other Building firms use builders quotes so they know what to price. This can be a waste of time for builders and their time in quoting for their jobs we feel customers should now pay for builders quotes throughout the United Kingdom and if they accept the quote the Quote fee would come off the Quote price.
attributes.background: We think customers should pay for building quotes instead of getting free quotes the reason why it is because customers and other builders use other building firms for free quotes and Waist builders times we think customers should pay for builders quotes and if I accepted the charge would be removed

rejection.details:
We are not clear what action you would like the UK Government or Parliament to take.

We might be able to accept a petition calling for a ban on builders providing free quotes for building work, if that's something you would like to see happen.
